result.summary: Adds unit test coverage for `PartiallySignedTransaction::Merge()` in `src/test/psbt_tests.cpp`. The new tests check that PSBTs with mismatched versions fail to merge, that `fallback_locktime` values are preserved or adopted as expected, and that `m_tx_modifiable` flags are merged across inputs.
result.problem: Portions of `PartiallySignedTransaction::Merge()` had no unit test coverage, leaving version mismatch rejection, fallback locktime propagation, and modifiable flag bitwise operations open to undetected regressions.
evidence: PR description demonstrates three specific mutations in `src/psbt.cpp` (allowing version mismatches, inverting fallback locktime conditions, and altering modifiable bitflag combination conditions) that pass existing test suites without failing.
result.changed_since_previous: Minor rebase and adjustments to test setup across the three commits.
result.card: Adds unit tests for PartiallySignedTransaction::Merge() in src/test/psbt_tests.cpp. It covers edge cases that previously had no test coverage, specifically rejecting merges between PSBTs of different versions, resolving fallback_locktime values, and combining m_tx_modifiable bitflags. The author provides mutation test examples in src/psbt.cpp that previously passed undetected.

risk.why: Touches only unit tests in test/psbt_tests.cpp, so any defect would only affect the test suite.
